theses.thesis: T1: EUV and service growth can sustain revenue expansion above 15% a year as AI capacity spending continues.
theses.signpost: Q4 2026 results show full-year 2026 net sales within or above the €34–39bn guidance, with service growing above 20% [1]. Invalidated if 2026 net sales fall below €34bn or EUV system sales decline y/y in any 2026 quarter.

theses.thesis: T2: Margins can stay near 50%+ gross as mix shifts to EUV and service, supporting earnings growth.
theses.signpost: Gross margin holds above the baseline floor in each 2026 quarterly report, with EPS beating consensus as it has in Q1 to Q3 2026 [3]. Invalidated if gross margin falls below that floor in any 2026 quarter, or EPS misses consensus two quarters in a row.

theses.thesis: T3: Customer concentration is a material risk that could cut revenue faster than the cycle would otherwise imply.
theses.signpost: Largest-customer share is reported in the FY2026 20-F, with a decline below 20% alongside rising unit shipments [1]. Invalidated if the largest customer's share falls below 20% in the FY2026 20-F with unit shipments rising.

theses.thesis: T4: The current price is fully valued: the shares need growth that history has not delivered for a decade.
theses.signpost: Consensus FY2027 revenue (€57.4bn, as stated in EUR by the data source) is cut by more than 10% in a 2027 quarterly update, or the share price falls below the implied value [3]. Invalidated if consensus and sustained orders lift the 10-year growth needed to justify the price below 15%.
